info.title: AppyRig
info.description:
Read-only live view of OpenRig agent teams across machines. Every verb reads the last snapshot each machine pushed to this hub; none sends anything to a seat. POST JSON-RPC 2.0 to /v1/rpc with header x-fli-principal (agent:<name>, cli or human[:surface]) and the hub session cookie or Authorization: Bearer <hub token>.

18 methods; 0 are human-only in whole or in part (`x-human-only`) and refused with `forbidden` for agent and cli principals.

Every error carries `data.failureMode` (the canonical name) beside the integer code.

methods.name: account.list
methods.summary: Claude accounts, each with the machines signed into it (read from every machine's last push, so a changed login moves a machine on the next push), its plan tier and where it came from, and the 5-hour and 7-day windows against their resets. monthly is always not-reported: no source carries one.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: db.schema
methods.summary: The live shape of the OpenRig database on a machine: tables, columns (type, nullability, primary key), foreign keys, the OpenRig version it was read under, and what changed since the previous OpenRig version seen (baseline on the first). Read-only: names and types only, never a row. status: 'no-openrig' (no database on that machine), 'unreadable' (reason says why), 'no-data' (older collector).

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: fleet.get
methods.summary: Every machine the hub knows: its liveness, last-seen time and last snapshot (what fleet:update carries).

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: handoff.get
methods.summary: One handoff in full: who sent it to whom, when, its state, and the whole message (redacted). bodyStatus 'pending' means the hub has not been sent the message yet; it does not mean the message is empty.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: handoff.list
methods.summary: Routed work as edges (from the sending seat to the owning seat), newest first.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: health.get
methods.summary: Machine health as each machine's collector last sampled it: Claude processes, tmux sessions, terminal shells and terminal apps (with their memory), memory used and total, memory pressure, swap. Each reading is a value or 'unavailable' with a reason, never 0. status 'no-data' means that machine's collector predates health (it is not an error and not a clean bill of health). sampleAgeMs is the age of the readings now.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: history.list
methods.summary: What callers did through the API. v1 has no write verbs and records nothing: recorded: false.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: machine.list
methods.summary: Machines with liveness, source health and seat counts by status; no seats or terminal text.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: queue.list
methods.summary: Queue rows (no bodies) as each machine last reported them, newest first.

params.name: state
params.summary: only rows in this state, e.g. pending

schema.description: only rows in this state, e.g. pending

params.name: destination
params.summary: only rows sent to this seat

schema.description: only rows sent to this seat

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: rig.entry
methods.summary: Where a rig's work came in: the earliest instruction across its seats' histories, and whether it came through the queue. 'unknown' says why it cannot tell; seatsWithoutHistory lists seats whose prompts are not visible.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: rig.file
methods.summary: One file of a rig, by the id rig.files gave (e.g. spec:rig.yaml), never by path. The text is redacted and capped at 256 KB (truncated says so).

params.name: fileId
params.summary: a file id from rig.files, e.g. spec:rig.yaml

schema.description: a file id from rig.files, e.g. spec:rig.yaml

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: rig.files
methods.summary: The files of a rig that its collector found next to its rig.yaml (rig.yaml, MISSION.md, CULTURE.md, LEARNED*.md, brief.md, REPORT.md, DEBRIEF.md; the spec's folder and its mission folder). Names and sizes only; read one with rig.file. status says why a list is empty: 'no-spec' (no rig.yaml found for it), 'no-data' (older collector), 'pending' (found, not received yet).

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: rig.topology
methods.summary: Rigs with their seats grouped by pod, per machine.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: seat.get
methods.summary: One seat in full, with its last terminal text (at most 200 lines).

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: seat.history
methods.summary: What an OpenRig seat said and did over time (prompts, replies, tool calls), from its Claude transcript; for replay. Tool results and thinking are never included.

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: seat.list
methods.summary: Seats across machines without terminal text, filtered by machine, rig or status (e.g. status: blocked).

params.name: status
params.summary: only seats in this state, e.g. blocked

schema.description: only seats in this state, e.g. blocked

result.name: result
result.description: The call envelope: `ok: true` with the value, or `ok: false` with a named refusal.

methods.name: seat.tail
methods.summary: The last N lines of a seat's terminal (default 50, at most 200), as the collector last captured them.

result.name: result
